status: Signal audit after listener described the string candidate as less banjo-like and its remaining attack as sharp or tinny. These words are listener feedback, not inferred from spectra.
protocol: Unnormalized frozen native review. Same performance Before/Candidate, no rerender. Channel power averaged, not coherentL/R summing. Hann PSD5–20ms/20–80ms/5–80ms and200–1200ms, FFT8192/65536; centroid and fixedbands70Hz–12kHz. Rough harmonic bands only for>=60ms windows: nominalh*f0 ±max(2/window_seconds Hz,2%h*f0), H1/H2–H6/H8–H12. First0–5ms reports only native time-domain peak/RMS. Rough short-window partial ratios describe broadband attack energy, not resolved mode decay. Calibration cancels in relative spectra; absolute level changes are separate.

coverage.Original_status: Original model has no physical change; all108 capture table entries and180 alternate-tuning native strum rows were exact in the independently validated candidate.

attack_5_80ms.scope: Every row aggregates all12 shape/wood constructions. Native Candidate minus Before. Same-pitch comparisons on different strings use different phrase positions and retained release state; paired version comparisons keep their performance identical.

assessment_limits: Native microphone waveform peak is an output-pressure proxy; dedicated Piezo is an independently selected capture. This corpus contains no isolated heave/moment pressure or physical F/T telemetry.
The immutable D-string direction leaves relative attack spectra unchanged before/after even though its calibrated level changes.
A sharpness cue can persist after upper-tail reduction; centroid or upper-band fraction alone does not establish the cause or a listener preference.

Force-release contour, native F/T moment projection and pressure cancellation require exact component diagnostics for the next causal ablation; these descriptors do not justify another balance-EQ change.

The review Before G4 first1.2s was proven byte-exact to all108 corresponding fresh Classic controls, so the short attack is independent of hold length. Original native captures are unchanged by the physical candidate according to independent native/table checks. No new render or normalization.

matched_G4_A4_string_comparison.scope: Same two pitches acrossD/G/highE. All12 constructions aggregated separately per technique/capture; retain phrase-position caveat from protocol. Median of paired deltas differs from difference of independent medians.

measured_conclusion.remaining_bright_upper_attack: The largest native5–80ms spectral brightness is Pick on highE in both microphones; Thumb/Finger are much lower. String change reduces highE6–12k energy fraction, but its2–6k attack fraction changes little while the held upper tail falls more strongly.
measured_conclusion.D_and_G: D relative attack spectra and crest remain unchanged by design despite lower calibrated absolute level. G brightness falls modestly, but both wound strings retain a stronger attack-versus-held upper-band contrast than highE.
measured_conclusion.causal_next_step: Compare exact native moment/heave pressure and the authorized travelling-burst suppression at matched windows. This separates a broadband forced release packet from periodic standing-field partials and their pressure projection; the current spectra alone cannot identify which is responsible.
